newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Take profits on ICTSI - Urbancorp.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Take profits on ICTSI - Urbancorp.

text.p: Urbancorp Securities advised investors on Tuesday to take profits on International Container Terminal Services Inc (ICTSI), saying it was overbought.

Analyst Jojo San Diego said ICTSI's share price had appreciated by more than 20 percent since the brokerage house recommended "a buy on weakness" about three and-a-half months ago at 16.75 pesos per share.
At its closing price of 20.25 pesos on Monday, the stock was trading at 24.7 times 1996 forecast earnings per share of 0.82-peso and 18.2 times the 1997 EPS of 1.11 pesos.
ICTSI closed higher at 20.75 pesos on Tuesday. The company runs the Manila International Container Terminal which handles about 70 percent of the country's container traffic.
